correction_pair_ruling: RULING Zero Z2b (2026-09-11 ~15:00 WITA, AFTER this cohort was first written): the authorised backfill kinds are Claim, Evidence, ObjectSuccessorEdge and IntelEvent. This correction pair exists solely so ObjectSuccessorEdge has a seed R2 can write -- the penalty figures, regulation numbers and dates are INVENTED like everything else in this file. z2b_production_eligibility: NOT PRODUCTION-ELIGIBLE. This cohort is SYNTHETIC — every instrument is spelled 'permenkumham-synth-*' and every figure is invented — so it is a TEST fixture set and NOT the cohort Z2b(a) authorises. Z2b(a) authorises at most 20 PUBLIC REGULATORY claims FULLY SOURCED from public documents (body hash of the real body, exact span, valid time, rights). Nothing here is sourced from a real instrument. THEREFORE the Z2b seed cohort is EMPTY until sourced: R2's --apply may write only whatever the legacy admission dry-run admits (expected 0), and not one row of this file. Sourcing a real cohort is DEFERRED work, named in brief.yml and in the PR body. R1 section 6's stop rule is why it was not invented instead: a figure that cannot be sourced from a public document stops the window, it does not get fabricated and labelled sourced.
